arguments.sql: SELECT u.gender, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by the gender of the cardholder, one row for female users and one for male users.
assumptions: Counted all transactions, labelled or not, including those with negative amounts or errors.
The user making a transaction is taken to be the user who holds the card.
